[LSER.18.2] **Sliding descriptive and dispersion stats are exact in v1.**
`mean` / `sum` / `count` / `stdev` / `variance` on `sliding` compile to the
raw-sample ring buffer (`SeriesBackendRingBuffer`), **exact** over the true window at O(window·rate)
state — so `mean = sum/count` holds. Their **`tumbling`** forms are *not* exact
in v1: the per-bucket backing they need is unimplemented (§ above), so they are
rejected, as every `tumbling` line is in this edition ([LSER.14.4.5]). v1 has
no exponentially-weighted (`decay`) profile and no sub-linear true-window
statistic.
